$comment: The ONE list of known accessibility gaps (lane a11y-statement, Do 1). Read by tooling/a11y/scan.mjs (a serious or critical axe violation fails CI unless a row here names its rule on its page, and a row whose rule no longer fires on its scanned pages is STALE and fails too) and by tooling/sites/gen-accessibility-statement.mjs, which publishes every row on nikatru.com/accessibility. tooling/ci/assert-a11y-statement.mjs holds the published page and this file to the same ids both ways. `axe` lists the axe-core rule ids the row tolerates (empty when the scan cannot see the gap); `pages` is repo-relative, or [] for a surface the site scan does not cover. `owner` is the lane that may fix it; `until` is the date the row is reviewed by, never a promise the page makes.

exceptions.what: In the dark colour scheme some links on the app pages are below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
exceptions.why: The app pages are generated from the catalogue by another lane that is changing them now; the fix lands with that change.

exceptions.what: Each product's name and its "Plans" heading are both level-2 headings; the second should be level 3.
exceptions.why: The pricing page's text is being changed by another lane; the heading level changes with it.

exceptions.criterion: 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks; 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) in a dark system theme
exceptions.what: The per-app privacy notice has no navigation landmark and no dark colour scheme.
exceptions.why: The notice is a legal page whose next change belongs to the data-rights lane.

exceptions.surface: the native apps on Apple devices
exceptions.what: No one has yet tested the apps with VoiceOver on an iPhone, iPad or Mac.
exceptions.why: No Apple device is available to us yet. The apps' accessibility tree is tested automatically on every change, which is not the same as a person using a screen reader.
